status: specified effective guided protocol; not an implemented Yb+ interferometer

geometry.mass_note: rounded 171 times 1.66053906660e-27 kg, illustrative inertial parameter, not precision ionic mass; uniform ground shift absorbed in measured ground mass in physical use
geometry.shape: qA=+q/2, qB=-q/2; q=d*s(t/t_r) outbound, d during hold, d*(1-s(u)) return; s(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5
geometry.closure: position, velocity, acceleration return to zero; omega*t_r and omega*t_hold are integer multiples of 2*pi
geometry.mode_note: two orthogonal guide modes at common initial/final height, mixed by a unitary coupler; never identify two orthogonal input rails with one output state

guide_boundary: The global-z linear potential and zero scalar offsets are physical specifications. Replacing z by z-q_r adds a branch-dependent scalar potential and changes the ground phase. Same force does not imply same phase.
hamiltonian: m*c^2+p^2/(2*m)+m*g*z+V_r+H_C(T)*(1+g*z/c^2-p^2/(2*m^2*c^2)); leading clock mass-energy coupling from G-R7 proper-time action
pulse_sequence: at common height: clock R_y(pi/2), or prepared energy-dephased mixture with identical populations
at common height t=0: path B(alpha_s)=exp[-i*pi*(cos(alpha_s)X+sin(alpha_s)Y)/4], alpha_s=0
0--5 ms: symmetric outward transport; 5--15 ms: hold; 15--20 ms: symmetric return
at common height t=20 ms: B(alpha_f)^dagger then port and clock-energy readout; alpha_f is the scanned analyzer phase
joint witness runs: replace analyzer by calibrated local rotations for XX, ZY, YZ, and ZZ; common clock phase referenced to the local oscillator
pulse_assumptions: ideal instantaneous pulses, with free evolution during finite pulses excluded only in this stated impulse limit
path coupler acts identically on g and the selected excited state
clock pulse has negligible differential vertical recoil; transverse motion is common and factorized
common-temperature scalar BBR response only; no branch-specific uncalibrated radiation bath
classical guides and lasers leave no unmodeled distinguishable controller record in this ideal unitary calculation
closure_audit: The same state-independent guide is tested with m_e=m*(1+eta), eta=h*nu(T)/(m*c^2). Finite-eta harmonic mass model is a diagnostic completion, not all-orders general relativity. At commensurate times the first-order residual closes; the nonzero finite-eta residual and overlap are reported.
next_decision: calibrate a specific guide/coupler implementation or reject it if its state-dependent shifts, controller records, or phase noise overwhelm the differential signal; do not add a new time law
